metadata_correction: The Figshare Readme.pdf claims axis-2 index 1=wet, 2=dry, but Impedance.mat means are [261.67489949, 19.63169622] kOhm for zero-based indices [0,1]. The article reports 261.67 kOhm dry and 19.63 kOhm wet. We therefore label data axis index 0=dry, 1=wet; source discrepancy is retained.
